tasks.label: Install development mod
tasks.command: $modsDirectory = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'VintagestoryData\Mods'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $modsDirectory | Out-Null; $archive = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}/Releases' -Filter 'vanillaexpanded_*.zip' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $archive) { throw 'CakeBuild did not produce a VanillaExpanded archive.' }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $archive.FullName -Destination $modsDirectory -Force; Write-Host "Installed $($archive.Name) to $modsDirectory"

tasks.label: Uninstall development mod
tasks.command: $archivePath = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'VintagestoryData\Mods\vanillaexpanded_999.99.9.zip'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archivePath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Uninstalled development mod from $archivePath"
